title: Chapter 660
text:
North Continent, capital of Raylan.

Zeglin slowly walked through the government building. Wherever he passed, whether it was officials, secretaries, or guards, they all turned a blind eye to him. It was as if he was just air, but if someone was about to bump into him, they would subconsciously avoid him.

When he arrived at the door of the leader's office, Zeglin did not stop. He pushed the door open and walked in. The guards outside did not react at all, as if they did not see him.

Inside the room, the leader of Raylan was talking to the military through the internal phone. He also ignored Zeglin. Zeglin tapped his forehead, and an invisible psychic energy spread out. It turned into a dozen invisible tentacles and entered the head of the Raylan leader, tampering with his memories.

The leader of Raylan suddenly paused. Confusion flashed across his face, and he returned to normal the next second. He continued to talk on the phone. In this short pause, his memories had already been tampered with.

Zeglin nodded expressionlessly, turned around, and left the way he came. As he walked, he triggered the psychic mark in his mind and communicated with Stephanie and the others from a thousand miles away.

"I checked their previous memories. Black Star's attitude toward them was normal. He used threats and did not know that the memories of these leaders had been tampered with. We can basically confirm that he did not notice anything unusual about this incident. Let's do it as soon as possible. He's not on guard now, but he won't be if we drag this out."

Stephanie's chuckle sounded in his mind. "Don't forget Albert's lesson. Black Star is even more cautious than the people of Antarta. It's stupid to let down our guard against him. However, you're right. When he leaves Black Star City next time, we'll go and ambush him. In his own territory, he'll be restrained."

"When I'm done, I'll meet up with you guys."

Zeglin nodded. He then activated his psychic energy and flew toward Theseus, who was also in the North Continent. This was his next target.

He was a member of Stephanie's team, a Grade A Psychic with the ability to tamper with memories. He left the team and acted on his own, planting fake memories in the leaders of the Six Nations one by one, distorting most of their understanding of Black Star and making them think that they were fighters fighting against power.

In his eyes, the political struggle of the surface civilization was just the deception of the weak. It was futile and childish, and he could easily play with it. If it were not for the trap that he set for Black Star, he would not have wasted his energy to use the ingenious method of tampering with the memories of a group of surface civilization natives.

…

The North Continent was a world of ice and snow, and there were many mountain ranges.

Zeglin quickly left the borders of Raylan and flew over the undulating glaciers.

As they flew over a mountain range, Zeglin's heart suddenly tightened as though it was being gripped by a large hand. A mysterious sense of crisis descended upon him as he suddenly raised his head to look at the sky.

Mysterious blue starlight seemed to penetrate the clouds, burning in the sky.

"What …"

In the blink of an eye, dark blue pillars of light suddenly descended from the sky, accompanied by a world-destroying shockwave!

Rumble!!

The earth cracked, as if a blue spear of lightning and thunder had been thrown by a god from the heavens into the mortal world!

The area within hundreds of miles was completely covered by the attack. Other than the blinding blue light, no other colors could be seen. Half of the mountain range was instantly flattened, and terrifying circular craters appeared on the ground like a dozen meteorites hitting a planet at the same time!

At the edge of the explosion area, Zeglin barely supported himself to fly in the air. His entire body was covered in burns, and he was shocked. He did not expect to be attacked so suddenly, and with such terrifying power.

"Cough!"

He could not help but spit out a mouthful of blood. Zeglin felt that his organs were about to shatter. He quickly retreated while looking around anxiously, trying to find traces of the enemy.

"Who is it? Come out!"

As soon as he said that, a blue meteor flew over at high speed from the horizon, leaving a long trail behind. It broke through the sound barrier and the clouds, stopping not far away and facing Zeglin.

"Black Star!"

Zeglin's eyes widened, and his face was filled with shock.

He did not expect Black Star to suddenly come to him.

Han Xiao opened his helmet, stared at Zeglin, and snorted coldly.

"Someone is indeed controlling the Six Nations behind the scenes. Otherwise, they wouldn't be acting so abnormally. Speak, why are you targeting Blue Star?"

Han Xiao pretended that he did not know that Stephanie and the others' target was him, pretending that Zeglin was the biggest mastermind.

This was because there were definitely more enemies behind Zeglin. If he took the initiative to attack and disrupt the enemy's deployment, he would be able to take control of the situation. If he did not have the Observer's Mark, he could only wait for the enemy to attack him. It was too passive, and there might be unrelated casualties.

But now, he could choose the battlefield and attack the enemy instead.

After confirming Zeglin's appearance, Han Xiao locked onto Zeglin's approximate coordinates through the spaceship's radar and used more than ten Psionic Sky Cannons to bombard this area indiscriminately. There was no need to be restrained in this desolate area.

The power of the Psionic Sky Cannons was even greater than the original Eye of God.

He did not know that the battlefield that Stephanie and the others had originally chosen was Black Star City. The Observer's Mark had saved Black Star City from the fate of being destroyed and turned into a battlefield for more than ten Calamity Grades.

Psychics were even more fragile than Mechanics. Seeing how heavily injured Zeglin was, Han Xiao knew that he had achieved great results.

Zeglin hurriedly used the Psychic Mark to turn his mind into a server, pulling Stephanie and the others into the group chat to share his vision.

"Sh * t, I've been discovered. Come and save me!"

Stephanie was shocked. "Black Star is indeed as cautious and observant as the rumors say … But luckily, he only discovered you."

Black Star had discovered Zeglin's tracks and attacked directly, disrupting Stephanie's plan. However, when she saw Han Xiao's performance, she calmed down.

She connected all of Han Xiao's actions. Black Star must have done something to the leaders of the Six Nations, so he discovered Zeglin and thought that he was the biggest enemy. However, Black Star did not know Zeglin's motive, nor did he know that there were nine Supers lying in wait for him. He simply thought that the enemy's target was Blue Star … In that case, the situation was still under control. Black Star still did not know that this was a trap for him.

"We only have one choice now, which is to change the plan and attack Black Star immediately. He hasn't discovered us yet. Zeglin, try your best to stall him. We'll head over immediately."

Stephanie made up her mind and was certain of it.

Black Star thought that Zeglin was the only enemy. When all nine of them appeared, they would definitely give Black Star a 'surprise'!

Stephanie and the others were quite far away. Even with the speed of a Calamity Grade, it would still take some time for them to arrive.

Zeglin's heart sank.

He was heavily injured, and the other party was a Mechanic who controlled psionic energy and had the codename Indestructible Body. He knew that he was definitely not Han Xiao's match. Without hesitation, Zeglin turned around and fled.

"Want to run? Do you think you can?"

Han Xiao clapped his hands, and the Army Boxes flew over, turning into an overwhelming Mech Legion that drowned Zeglin in the blink of an eye.

The Psychic class countered the Mechanic class, and the Mechanic class countered the Psychic class. After all, psychic attacks were useless against machinery. Only psychic attacks were effective.

Boom! Boom!

Boom! The long-range troops and artillery troops fired psionic cannons one after another, blasting through Zeglin's psychic barrier. The mechanical soldiers waved electromagnetic, vibration, high temperature, laser, and other multi-functional melee weapons, sweeping past Zeglin time and time again, leaving all kinds of wounds on his body.

Zeglin resisted with all his might, running for his life. However, he was surrounded. The new generation of Mech Legion, together with the bonuses of the Truth Mechanic, was much stronger.

Without needing Han Xiao to do anything, Zeglin was already in danger, and his health was dropping steadily.

Han Xiao released his Mechanical Force bonuses on the side and paid attention to his surroundings. He took the initiative to attack to lure the enemy out. He still did not know how many people there were in this group of mysterious hunters, so he remained vigilant.

After fighting for a while, Zeglin was covered in wounds and blood. His eyes were bloodshot.

"Argh!"

Zeglin suddenly roared, and his psychic energy turned into a huge drill, sweeping him into the Mech Legion's encirclement.

He was already at the end of his rope, and this attack contained all his strength.

The psychic drill broke through layer after layer of encirclement and was about to kill its way out of the army.

At this time, the shield troops suddenly gathered and blocked in front of Zeglin. At the same time, they released their psionic shields, which condensed together and turned into a psionic barrier hundreds of meters wide.

The invisible psychic drill collided with the thick psionic barrier!

Whoosh!

Countless energy sparks exploded at the point of impact, like sparks flying when metal was being cut.

The impact of the drill lasted for quite a while before it quickly weakened. Zeglin's eyes widened unwillingly. He did not manage to break through this psionic barrier.

Fatigue surged into his mind like a tide. He felt drowsy, which was the side effect of overusing his psychokinesis.

If it was any other time, he would be able to recover after a short rest with his psychic energy. However, he was surrounded at this time!

The moment Zeglin froze, countless psionic cannons hit his body.

Boom! Boom!

Blue explosions appeared one after another!

His flesh and blood were burned to ashes the moment they left his body.

Mechanical soldiers dragged their high-temperature cutting weapons and slashed Zeglin's body, sending him flying in midair.

Kacha!

An arm flew into the air and was cut off.

Kacha!

This time, it was a calf!

Boom!

The next second, dozens of mechanical soldiers attacked together, and Zeglin was instantly turned into a pile of minced meat. His limbs and organs exploded like fireworks, and blood rained down.

He died on the spot!

The Mech Legion stopped moving, and only the sound of the wind could be heard on the battlefield.

Han Xiao was stunned. The battle had ended faster than he had expected. If he remembered correctly, this was the first Calamity Grade to die in the hands of the Mech Legion.

Oh my god, my kind Mech Legion has killed someone.

"This guy is a little fragile …"

Han Xiao scratched the stubble on his chin.

If he did not have the tank talent, with his Endurance, his health would only be slightly more than 70,000. Psychics were strong in offense and weak in defense. This was the consensus of all Supers. If Zeglin had not focused on breaking through the encirclement and had attacked him with psychic attacks instead, Han Xiao would have probably suffered some light injuries.

Unfortunately, Zeglin seemed to be afraid of his Indestructible Body and did not have the courage to fight him to the death.

Killing Zeglin in a one-on-one duel was a good thing that Han Xiao did not expect. Not only did he weaken the enemy's overall strength, the Promotion Mission on his interface also showed a 'Completed' status.

This meant that as long as Han Xiao was willing, he could complete his Race Evolution at any time and place!

"That's settled …" Han Xiao felt relaxed.

He was even more confident that he could complete his Promotion at any time.

The accumulated experience was enough for him to reach level 195 directly after his Promotion, reaching the upper limit of a Truth Mechanic.

At his level, being able to maintain such a leveling speed was all thanks to the huge accumulation from Version 2.0.

At this time, the sound of something breaking through the air could be heard.

Hu!

Figures flew over from the horizon and stopped in midair. It was Stephanie and the others. They all looked at Zeglin's corpse, and their expressions changed.

Black Star had already killed Zeglin in the short time they had spent on the road?

Stephanie narrowed her eyes. She did not have any feelings for her teammates, so she was not angry. She only stared at Han Xiao with sparkles in her eyes.

He's indeed a powerful guy. His Excellency Thousand Shadows will definitely like him.

As this thought flashed through her mind, Stephanie did not intend to explain to Han Xiao. She made a hand gesture, and the others spread out and surrounded Han Xiao from afar. They blocked all escape routes and stared at him with ill intentions.

Stephanie looked at Han Xiao's face, expecting him to show a shocked expression after falling into her trap.

Seeing this, Han Xiao closed his helmet and covered his face, not showing it to her. He had already succeeded in luring the snake out of its hole, so he could not be bothered to show off his Oscar spirit.

Stephanie could not help but be disappointed. Although she knew that Black Star was definitely extremely shocked and was just controlling his expression and not showing it, she still wanted to see the expression of her prey, but she did not get what she wanted.

"Nine Calamity Grades … Hmm, this is probably all the enemies. How generous."

Han Xiao secretly heaved a sigh of relief. If he was alone, it would definitely be a tough battle. Luckily, he had prepared ahead of time and invited all the heroes to help him.

Philip had already called Wilton, Nagojin, and the others to come over and help. He only needed to hold on for a while. He was not as fragile as Zeglin.

Furthermore, he did not expect to gain such a huge reward from this trip.

Under the mechanical suit's helmet, Han Xiao stared at Stephanie, who was in the lead, and sized her up. He then smiled meaningfully.
